question: Should OpenClaw add durable rootSessionKey and session-chain traceId fields for spawned sessions, and should traceId be a new chain identifier or align with existing diagnostic/usage-family lineage?
rationale: The implementation is bounded, but it creates persisted session fields plus Gateway/tool API semantics that need stable maintainer intent before another fix PR is useful.

options.title: Add Minimal Spawn-Chain Contract
options.body: Add optional parent/root/trace/depth metadata for spawned sessions only, with additive schema, projections, docs, and tests while leaving traversal APIs for later.

options.title: Align With Resolver Lineage First
options.body: Keep this issue open until sessions.resolve and usage-family lineage semantics settle, then align spawned-session metadata with that broader contract.

options.title: Reject Durable Root/Trace Fields
options.body: Keep current parent/depth behavior and limit future work to tooling or docs if maintainers do not want a new persisted chain identifier.

recommendation.title: Add Minimal Spawn-Chain Contract
recommendation.body: Add optional parent/root/trace/depth metadata for spawned sessions only, with additive schema, projections, docs, and tests while leaving traversal APIs for later.
